title: Flatness of one-homogeneous one-phase Bernoulli minimizers in dimensions at most six
abstract: A Lean 4 formalization of the flatness half of the main theorem of the OpenAI preprint "The critical dimension for one-phase Bernoulli minimizers" (September 24, 2026): for 1 ≤ d ≤ 6, every nonnegative, nonzero, one-homogeneous global minimizer u of the one-phase Bernoulli energy J(v; B) = ∫_B |∇v|² + 1_{v > 0} in ℝᵈ is flat, that is, u(x) = max(⟪x, e⟫, 0) for almost every x, for some unit vector e. The minimizer class is the one of Alt and Caffarelli, written out from Mathlib definitions: on every ball B, u ∈ H¹(B) and J(u; B) ≤ J(v; B) for every v ∈ H¹(B) with v − u ∈ H¹₀(B), with weak gradients and H¹₀(B) (the closure of C_c^∞(B)) defined in the statement itself. The proof follows the preprint's universal-certificate method; the classical regularity theory of one-phase minimizers that the preprint cites is proved, in this repository or its dependencies, and the classification in dimensions d ≤ 4, which the preprint cites, is proved by the same exclusion method with new certificates.
